system.description:
Will Amp

Starting at 20th level, when you would enter your Crash state, you can spend 4 Focus, perfecting it for the next minute. Once you do this, you cannot do so again for 10 minutes.
system.summary: Perfected Crash (20th level, 4 Focus): Crash's benefits, perfected for 1 minute.

rules.text: Once per casting +5d10 Ninjutsu damage (the Crash option); three or more Moldings on one casting; your Ninjutsu treat immunity as resistance (on this effect).
rules.label: Chakra Surge: Crash (Perfected)

rules.text: Once per casting, Ninjutsu you cast deal +1d10 damage (2d10 at 7th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 15th, 5d10 at 19th; half the dice for an area). This is added automatically when you cast.
You can use two or more Moldings on one casting; you can use the Draw Reserves skill action as an Action.
